_comment_canre: canre, the CAN analysis library, from the public repo at one commit (port plan "The CAN analysis library"; reviewer, 2026-10-26, port step 0 for the interposer): canre_pin.py installs that commit into the worktree's scratch/ and refuses any other canre.
_comment_can-tools: can-tools, whose canbench/ is the CAN adapter package, at one commit (user ruling 2026-10-30, via the reviewer: each project pins its own can-tools and moves it itself): can_tools_pin.py writes that commit's canbench/ out of the CAN_TOOLS_DIR clone into the worktree's scratch/ and refuses any other canbench. Since 5220d374 (2026-11-18, shared/bench SPEC section 8's adapter roles) every real bench adapter is opened by its canctl role through its canbench.bench_roles (adapter_roles.py), and the Linux fixes come from its canbench.live.linux_fixes. Since ec7cefe9 (2026-11-19, the charge-interposer reviewer's bench-layer item) the links, the modes and the opens go through canbench.bench_layer, the bench-role layer both ESP projects share, and the adapter-open scan is its canbench.bench_scan.
